simple.meaning: מִגְרָפָה (migrâphâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something thrown off (by the spade), i.e. a clod.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִגְרָפָה (H4053) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִגְרָפָה (H4053) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִגְרָפָה (migrâphâh) / H4053 is traced through Joel 1:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: something thrown off (by the spade), i.e. a clod
definitions.full: H4053. megraphah [ מֶגְרָפָה ] noun feminine shovel (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic מַגְרוֺפִיתָא ; Arabic (see Lane)) only plural מֶגְרְפֹתֵיהֶם Joel 1:17 (Thes clods , after Jewish interpreters, so AV RV, compare however Mei Joel 100 f ; ᵐ5 Me ארותיהם their cribs , of cattle; meaning of clause dubious).
